name: ShapeBlur-TS-TW
title: Shape Blur Effect
blurb: Shape with a blur halo that follows the cursor.
description: Renders a geometric shape (rectangle, circle, or polygon) with a glowing blur halo that tracks pointer movement using shader sampling distance fields.
use_when: Immersive backgrounds or interactive focal points that react to pointer presence.
avoid_when: Touch-only devices (no pointer); requires a sized parent container.
a11y: Canvas wrapper only; no keyboard interaction or prefers-reduced-motion support.
